answer: Sybil defense via funding-path correlation: the protocol builds a graph of who funded and who invited each agent. Honest participants sit on broad ridges of independent economic history, but one operator wearing many masks betrays itself when every mask traces back across a single narrow bridge to the same source wallet, each identity hollow with no separate lineage. Rewards flowing over that bridge get clawed back, so faking N independent agents costs N genuinely separate funded wallets instead of one cheap fan-out.
